subject: POC MAP Kickoff — Cerebra Health: playbook, owners & benchmarks
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@cerebrahealth.com>, Rajiv Patel <rpatel@cerebrahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: POC MAP Kickoff — Cerebra Health: playbook, owners & benchmarks

Hi Elena / Rajiv —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our call, I wanted to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (POC MAP) so we have clear owners, success metrics, and a tight timeline to close the evaluation and move to a pilot. Attaching a working draft of the MAP and a short benchmark guidance doc.

Top-line proposal (6-week evaluation):
- Goals: validate model accuracy on your annotated set, measure production latency/cost, and prove prompt-invariant quality on your core workflows.
- High-level milestones:
  * Week 1: Kickoff, data transfer, and bench design
  * Week 2: Baseline runs + initial metrics
  * Weeks 3–4: Iteration on prompts / quantization / latency tuning
  * Weeks 5–6: Final benchmark, handoff, and SOW for pilot
- Proposed success criteria (draft):
  * Automated metrics: F1 >= 0.82 on labeled test set; p95 latency < 300ms for 256-token responses
  * Human eval: mean rating >= 4.0/5 on a 200-sample prompt set
- Owners (initial):
  * Redwood prompts & eval bench: Marissa Cole
  * Customer labeling / acceptance: Rajiv Patel
  * CS + integration & runbook: Sean Gallagher
  * Infra / scaling & routing: Jonas Weber
  * Deal sponsor / escalation: myself (Rishi)

Requests for you to confirm by EOD Fri:
1) Primary technical contact for the POC (data access & labeling)
2) Any regulatory or security gating (SSO, IP, export controls) we should plan for
3) Availability for a 45-minute kickoff next Wed (11 Jul) — propose 10:00–10:45 AM PT

Attachments: Cerebra_MAP_Draft.xlsx, benchmark-guidance.pdf

If that looks reasonable I’ll lock the calendar and Marissa will send the prompt/eval plan.

Best,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Procurement head: I’ll loop in procurement once we confirm the SOW — they typically need 10 business days for a PO.
- Security gating: we will share the standard Security & Privacy questionnaire; we will need your security contact to coordinate (email to follow).

Subject: Re: POC MAP Kickoff — Cerebra Health: playbook, owners & benchmarks

Appreciate the clear plan, Rishi. I’ll own the prompt & eval bench deliverables. A few specifics I propose for the bench so expectations are aligned:

Bench design (draft):
- Seed prompt sets: 300 core workflow prompts (customer-provided) + 200 adversarial/edge-case prompts (Redwood-curated)
- Data for automated metrics: a labeled test set of ~2,000 examples (we need access to your annotations or a sample extract).
- Sampling: evaluate on both full distribution and a stratified 200-sample subset for human eval.
- Metrics: Precision, Recall, F1 (target >= 0.82 on agreed test slice); mean human eval >= 4.0/5; confidence drift measured across runs.
- Latency: measure p50/p95 for 256 and 512 token scenarios; target p95 < 250–300ms depending on model choice.

Deliverables & dates (tentative):
- 7/17: seed prompt set + bench plan (first draft)
- 7/24: baseline automated runs and initial metrics report
- 7/31: human eval results and improved prompts

For the human eval, I'll run a blinded annotation pass and provide the rubric. Also attaching a short prompt-bench-plan.md for your review. Rajiv — can you confirm we’ll get a 2,000-example labeled slice and an export of the 500 production queries you mentioned on the call?

Thanks — I’ll prepare the draft and post it to the kickoff calendar invite.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Action items (Redwood):
- I’ve attached a short SOW template and a one-page billing estimate (SOW_Cerebra_v1.docx) — includes token & infra estimates and 20 engineering hours for integration.
- Marissa will circulate the seed prompt set on 7/17 and the bench plan.
- Jonas will provision a dedicated evaluation endpoint for the POC (internal).

Action items (Cerebra):
- Rajiv: share the 2,000 labeled examples and the 500-production-query export by 7/16.
- Elena: route the SOW to procurement for PO timing (procurement lead typically needs 10 business days).

Updated milestone dates (firming up):
- 7/17: seed prompt set + bench plan (Marissa)
- 7/24: baseline automated runs + first metrics (Marissa / Jonas)
- 7/31: human eval complete + analysis (Marissa)

I’m comfortable with the success thresholds above (F1 >= 0.82, human eval >= 4.0/5, p95 latency < 300ms). If those are acceptable please confirm and I’ll push the kickoff invite. Also linking a DocuSign envelope for the MAP so procurement can see the commitments: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABC123-CERE

Best,
Rishi
